63553d101bdd: Why build a B2C website for my travel agency?
c06589ae4031: A B2C website lets your travel agency sell its travel products directly online, without relying solely on walk-in visits or phone calls.
2a41bdc5274f: With a professional website, your customers can explore your travel offers, browse your destinations, compare trips and send booking requests at any time, 24/7.
590495e67203: A website also improves your agency's visibility on Google and attracts new customers searching for trips online. Today it is an essential tool for growing your business and strengthening your digital presence in an increasingly competitive travel market.
e6844c5b3f0d: What features does a Travelife travel agency website include?
b624cc59c32e: Websites built by Travelife are specifically designed to meet the needs of travel agencies and tour operators.
197db2a0c8fc: They include a travel search engine, booking modules for flights, hotels and tours, and a secure payment system so customers can book their trips directly online.
8b7caffb8a56: The website also includes an administration area (back office) where you can easily manage your travel offers, publish content, track customer requests and view bookings. The goal is to give you a complete platform to run your travel business simply and efficiently.
91baa1f0a073: Is the website connected to GDSs and travel suppliers?
75f005f43eab: Yes. The B2C website can be connected to various suppliers and GDS systems to automatically display availability for flights, hotels and other travel services.
ba4537b456de: Through API connections, your website can access a wide catalog of offers from airlines, hotels and international distribution platforms.
9b1d32c30ac2: These integrations let you offer up-to-date prices, automate bookings and expand your product catalog without managing each offer manually.
6ecc36cff4bf: Is the website optimized for Google search?
267e7b7686e8: Yes. Travelife websites are built to be search engine optimized (SEO) to improve your visibility on search engines such as Google.
7795c1f9f1d0: The site structure, code optimization, structured data and dedicated destination pages all help improve the indexing of your content.
d23383578340: You can also publish blog articles, travel guides or destination-specific pages to attract qualified traffic and grow your digital presence.
3f25fd1fea74: Does the website work on smartphones and tablets?
d85cd5429d46: Yes. All websites built by Travelife are responsive, meaning they automatically adapt to every type of screen: computers, tablets and smartphones.
dc60eb954321: Today, a large share of travel searches are made on mobile phones. It is therefore essential to offer smooth, fast browsing to ensure a good user experience.
33158236db15: A responsive website also improves your Google ranking and lets your customers browse your offers or make a booking easily from their phone.
f33f09e4189f: Booking requests sent from your website are automatically recorded in your Travelife back office.
c8a5b4fe5222: You can track every customer request, send personalized quotes, convert requests into confirmed bookings and centralize all customer information.
ffd61415e588: This centralized management eliminates manual follow-up in Excel or by email and saves you valuable time when processing travel requests.
4f306feaac88: Can my website project be funded by the Go Siyaha program?
3ebeb0eafbd9: The Go Siyaha program supports the digital transformation of travel agencies in Morocco and can fund a significant share of technology projects.
9d0fc3b6d116: Travelife's digital solutions, such as building a B2C website connected to a booking system, can qualify under this program.
8fac1805e5e4: The program gives agencies access to support and funding to modernize their digital tools, improve their online visibility and strengthen their competitiveness in the travel market.
a03b40523805: How long does it take to build a travel agency website?
3f3f691f8dac: A travel agency website can be built relatively quickly with Travelife solutions designed specifically for the travel industry.
1c3868bec9c3: Depending on the level of customization, the features required and the integrations needed, your website can go live within a few weeks.
9082f4a7c55c: The Travelife team supports you throughout the project: website setup, content integration, back-office training and launch of your digital platform.
53553543b1be: How much does a travel agency website cost with Travelife?
8fe22f94c2e7: A Travelife travel agency website costs 99 € per month with the Starter plan or 399 € per month with the Advanced plan, plus a one-time setup fee (500 € for Starter, 1,500 € for Advanced).
1a66e586033c: The Premium / Enterprise plan, designed for large agencies and networks, is available on quote. An optional Launch Pack also lets you have your 10 flagship tours uploaded (+ 300 €) on the Starter plan.
5a392bcbbea2: Travelife takes no commission on your online sales: the subscription is fixed, with no hidden fees. The full comparison is available on the B2C website pricing page.
c31ee97f7a91: What is the difference between the Travelife Starter, Advanced and Premium packages?
edc314f62a29: The difference lies mainly in API connectivity and support level. Travelife Starter suits agencies that sell their own products (direct hotel contracts, tours and activities, CMS, forms and blog), without external APIs, with standard support by email or ticket.
9a8d7adbe20b: Travelife Advanced, the core offer for outbound agencies and OTAs, adds 2 APIs (one hotel feed and one flight feed, excluding supplier credential fees), the Packages module, setup of your pricing rules and priority support during business hours.
dc314f330859: Premium / Enterprise offers unlimited access to the API hub (Amadeus GDS, Sabre GDS, Travelgate, multiple bed banks), dedicated servers and 24/7 VIP support.
e7cd9186f99c: What happens after I submit the quote form?
cda59247e341: After you submit the form, a member of the Travelife team will contact you shortly to confirm the chosen package and understand your business: own products, API needs, number of products, timelines.
4e640986e4b7: You then receive your free, no-obligation quote. Once the project starts, Travelife handles domain setup, integration of your logo and brand guidelines, followed by training: 2 hours of online training for Starter, a 6 to 8-hour pack for Advanced.
315d676ea0b4: You can also request a demo of the B2C website before committing, from the Contact us page.
4cc2f2560548: Do I need WordPress or technical skills to manage my travel agency website?
12dadf34afb6: No. The Travelife website is managed from the Travelife back office, without WordPress or any other external CMS, and without technical skills.
35ab3e78e17c: The Theme Builder lets you choose the theme, colors, menu and footer with a real-time preview; the Menu Builder organizes navigation; the Page Builder builds each page by adding modules (trips, search engines, forms, marketing content).
8936c2b7061d: Built-in SEO tools let you configure the titles, descriptions and content of each page to improve your agency's visibility on Google.
0089dce0508c: Is my travel agency website covered by a warranty and maintenance?
6758248c5def: Yes. A complete website build by Travelife includes 1 year of warranty and maintenance.
3e5c495937d2: Every Travelife website meets the technical standards of a professional site, with no hidden extras: responsive design for mobile and tablet, SEO optimization, HTTPS security and GDPR compliance.
6b4ab6edae93: Platform updates are automatic and your data belongs to you, with full data portability. Your website stays fast and secure without your agency having to handle the technical side.
